Theme

Latin word

causa

causa, causae f.

noun, first declension

a person’s case, the position someone is in; a case at law; one’s side in it; a pretext, an excuse; a cause, one of the reasons; motive, reason (for doing something); reason, cause, ground

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.112: alius in eādem causā nōn dēbeat; Cic. Att. 11.2.3: quī videntur in eādem causā esse

  • excuse
